newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bayccorp to focus on ledger management.
newsitem.headline: Bayccorp to focus on ledger management.

text.p: Baycorp Holdings Ltd Chairman Jim Boult said on Tuesday a new focus for the debt collector and credit reporting agency would be ledger management.
Boult told the annual meeting it had become obvious that the sooner Baycorp became involved in debt collection the better it was for the customer.

"We have therefore, over the years, encouraged our customers to give us their debts at an early date rather than waiting until the trail has gone cold and the collection becomes more difficult," he said.
This had led the company to launch a product under which Baycorp would take responsibliity for managing the ledgers of its clients' debtors from the point at which the debt is incurred.

"We believe substantial savings are available to our clients through this product, utilising Baycorp's expert and proven debt collection and management systems and personnel expertise. As a result, we predict that this part of our business will become a substantial profit centre," he said.

Baycorp was in discussions with two government departments to undertake ledger management for them. Boult said Baycorp had the capacity to do the job, but that it would take up to two years for the contracts to come to fruition.

The company had also entered an arrangement with a moderate sized mortgage lender to take control of its portfolio and with a new company, Finance House Ltd, established in the "sub prime" lending areas, to manage its ledger.
Baycorp believed Finance House had identified a niche not currently provided for in New Zealand in the sub prime areas.
As a result, Baycorp had taken a 30 percent holding for NZ$600,000. One of the other shareholders in Finance House is an American company, which offered the same service in the U.S.
Meanwhile, Boult said it would make some of its information available on the Internet, through Baynet CRA, in association with the National Business Review.
The service would open Baynet's databases, allowing access to Valuation New Zealand data, recent property sales, New Zealand Post changes of address and vehicle ownership checks.
The only part of its service that would not be available would be credit reports on individuals, which are protected by the Privacy Act. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
